items.title: IDmlEntity
items.description: Representation of a DML entity

items.title: EntityConstructor
items.description:
A type-only representation of a MikroORM entity. Since we generate
entities on the fly, we need a way to represent a type-safe
constructor and its instance properties.

items.title: DMLSchema
items.description:
Representation of DML schema. It must be a key-value pair
with string based keys and properties/relationships
as the value.

items.title: KnownDataTypes
items.description: The supported data types

items.title: RelationshipTypes
items.description: List of available relationships at DML level

items.title: IsNullableRelation
items.description: Return true if the relationship is nullable

items.title: PropertyMetadata
items.description: The meta-data returned by the property parse method

items.title: PropertyType
items.description:
Definition of a property type. It should have a parse
method to get the metadata and a type-only property
to get its static type

items.title: RelationshipOptions
items.description: Options accepted by all the relationships

items.title: RelationshipMetadata
items.description:
The meta-data returned by the relationship parse
method

items.title: RelationshipType
items.description:
Definition of a relationship type. It should have a parse
method to get the metadata and a type-only property
to get its static type

items.title: InferForeignKeys
items.description:
From a IDmlEntity, infer the foreign keys name and type for
"belongsTo" relation meaning "hasOne" and "ManyToOne"

items.title: InferBelongsToFields
items.description: Infer fields for a belongsTo relationship

items.title: InferHasOneFields
items.description: Infer fields for a hasOne relationship

items.title: InferHasManyFields
items.description: Infer fields for hasMany relationship

items.title: InferManyToManyFields
items.description: Infer fields for manyToMany relationship

items.title: InferSchemaFields
items.description: Infers the types of the schema fields from the DML entity

items.title: InferSchemaFieldsForModuleServices
items.description:
Infers the types of the schema fields from the DML entity
for module services

items.title: InferSchemaProperties
items.description: Infers the schema properties without the relationships

items.title: ExtractEntityRelations
items.description: Extracts names of relationships from a schema

items.title: Infer
items.description: Helper to infer the schema type of a DmlEntity

items.title: EntityCascades
items.description:
The actions to cascade from a given entity to its
relationship.

items.title: InferTypeOf
items.description: Helper to infer the instance type of a IDmlEntity once converted as an Entity

items.title: InferEntityType
items.description: Used in the module sdk internal service to infer propert entity typings from DML

items.title: InferIndexableProperties
items.description: Infer all indexable properties from a DML entity including inferred foreign keys and excluding relationship

items.title: InferCheckConstraintsProperties
items.description:
Returns a list of columns that could be mentioned
within the checks

items.title: CheckConstraint
items.description: Options supported when defining a PostgreSQL check
